**Analysis Summary:**

The test image shows the **lower leaf surface** with:
- Numerous small, scattered **reddish-brown pustules** (uredinia)
- **White/cream spore masses** clustered around lesions
- Fine reticulate venation visible (confirming lower surface)
- Yellow halos around some lesion areas

**Comparison with candidates:**
- **Soybean_rust** ✓ — Perfect match: lower leaf surface pustules, tan/reddish-brown, scattered; the reference image upper-right panel shows identical pattern
- **Downy_mildew** ✗ — Whitish crusty mass inside pods, not scattered pustules on leaves
- **Powdery_Mildew** ✗ — Broad white powdery coating on upper surface, not discrete scattered pustules
- **Cercospora** ✗ — Dark purple/bronze leathery lesions on upper surface only
- **Bacterial_Pustule** ✗ — Larger irregular lesions with greenish-yellow halos
- **Septoria_brown_spot** ✗ — Irregular dark brown spots, mainly on yellowing leaves
- **Sudden_death_syndrome** ✗ — Interveinal chlorosis/necrosis with veins remaining green

The scattered reddish-brown uredinia on the lower leaf surface, producing white spore masses, is the hallmark of **soybean rust**.
